name: Exp_Sidus
summary: This EA trades based on the Sidus indicator, which uses dual EMA and dual LWMA crossover signals to identify trend direction. It opens buy positions on upward crossover signals and sell positions on downward crossover signals, with configurable stop-loss, take-profit, and money management options.
summary_zh: 该EA基于Sidus指标进行交易，Sidus指标利用双EMA和双LWMA交叉信号来识别趋势方向。在向上交叉信号时开多仓，在向下交叉信号时开空仓，并提供可配置的止损、止盈和资金管理选项。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略是Sidus趋势跟踪系统，通过快速EMA(18)与慢速EMA(28)以及快速LWMA(5)与慢速LWMA(8)的交叉组合来判断趋势方向。入场条件为：当Sidus指标的UpValue缓冲区有有效非零值时触发做多信号，当DnValue缓冲区有有效非零值时触发做空信号。出场条件分为两类：一是止损/止盈触发被动出场，二是由反向信号触发主动平仓，EA会向前遍历历史K线确认是否存在反向信号以决定是否平仓。仓位管理支持五种模式：基于自由保证金、基于余额、基于扣除亏损后的自由保证金、基于扣除亏损后的余额、以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择计算方式，支持从保守到激进的多种资金分配策略。该EA还提供了买卖方向的独立开关控制，可以仅做多、仅做空或双向交易。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy of this EA is the Sidus trend-following system, which uses a combination of fast EMA(18) and slow EMA(28) crossovers along with fast LWMA(5) and slow LWMA(8) crossovers to determine trend direction. Entry conditions are: a buy signal is triggered when the Sidus indicator's UpValue buffer has a valid non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE reading, and a sell signal is triggered when the DnValue buffer has a valid non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE reading. Exit conditions are twofold: passive exits via stop-loss or take-profit, and active exits triggered by opposite signals, where the EA iterates forward through historical bars to confirm the presence of a reverse signal before closing positions. Position sizing supports five margin modes: based on free margin, based on balance, based on free margin minus losses, based on balance minus losses, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled through the MM parameter for risk proportion and the MMMode parameter for calculation method, supporting a range of allocation strategies from conservative to aggressive. The EA also provides independent on/off switches for buy and sell directions, allowing long-only, short-only, or bi-directional trading configurations.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot size, meaning per MMMode

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式：自由保证金/余额/扣损自由保证金/扣损余额/固定手数

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing buy positions on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow closing sell positions on reverse signal

pros: 双均线交叉组合提供较可靠的趋势确认信号，减少虚假突破
支持五种仓位计算模式，资金管理灵活度高
买卖方向和开平仓可独立控制，策略配置灵活
使用IsNewBar机制避免同根K线重复交易
止损止盈参数可配置，基本风险控制到位
pros_en: Dual moving average crossover combination provides reliable trend confirmation signals, reducing false breakouts
Five position sizing modes offer high flexibility in money management
Independent control over buy/sell directions and open/close operations allows flexible strategy configuration
IsNewBar mechanism prevents duplicate trades on the same bar
Configurable stop-loss and take-profit parameters provide basic risk control
cons: 止损默认值1000点和止盈2000点过大，可能导致大量浮亏
信号确认逻辑中向前遍历历史K线的循环可能效率低下且逻辑不够清晰
缺少点差过滤和最大持仓限制，在极端行情下风险较大
依赖自定义Sidus指标文件，如果指标缺失EA将无法运行
注释为乱码（编码问题），严重影响代码可读性和维护性
cons_en: Default stop-loss of 1000 points and take-profit of 2000 points are excessively large, potentially leading to significant floating losses
The forward-iterating historical bar loop for signal confirmation may be inefficient and its logic is unclear
Lacks spread filter and maximum position limits, posing significant risk in extreme market conditions
Depends on a custom Sidus indicator file; if the indicator is missing the EA cannot run
Comments are garbled due to encoding issues, severely hurting code readability and maintainability
improvements: 添加点差过滤器，避免在高点差环境下入场
优化反向信号确认逻辑，避免遍历过多历史K线导致性能问题
增加移动止损或保本止损功能，锁定盈利减少回撤
improvements_en: Add a spread filter to avoid entering trades during high-spread conditions
Optimize the reverse signal confirmation logic to avoid iterating through excessive historical bars which causes performance issues
Add a trailing stop or break-even feature to lock in profits and reduce drawdown

risk_points: 止损止盈默认值过大，在剧烈行情中可能承受较大浮亏
缺少点差过滤，高点差时入场可能滑点严重
反向信号确认需遍历历史K线，极端情况下循环次数不可控
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit values are excessively large, potentially leading to significant floating losses during volatile markets
No spread filter means entries during high-spread conditions may suffer severe slippage
Reverse signal confirmation requires iterating through historical bars; in extreme cases the loop count is uncontrolled
